column1: 22947§solidarity§ˌsɒlɪˈdærəti§Downtrodden people will never be able to make any effective protest until they achieve solidarity.§被压迫的人们只有**团结一致**才能做出有效的抗议。§
22948§outline§ˈaʊtlaɪn§The guide gave us a brief outline of the museum's history.§导游向我们简要**概述**了这座博物馆的历史。§改译文：原译「大致介绍」的「介绍」不是 outline（概述）的意思，改为「简要概述」
22949§blank§blæŋk§Would you mind my asking about your salary? Or we can leave it blank.§你介意我问一下你的薪水吗？或者我们也可以把这一项**空着**。§改译文：原译「不填这一项」括不出 blank（空白的），改为「把这一项空着」
22950§photocopy§ˈfəʊtəʊkɒpi§Let's go and photocopy the article.§我们去把这篇文章**复印**一份吧。§
22951§accessory§əkˈsesəri§The uniforms for women in the company were white frocks decorated with purple, white and green accessories.§这家公司的女式工作服是配有紫色、白色和绿色**装饰物**的白色裙装。§
22952§dean§diːn§At the top of the faculty is a dean.§**院长**是学院里的一把手。§
22953§compensate§ˈkɒmpenseɪt§Nothing can compensate for the loss of one's health.§失去的健康是无法**弥补**的。§
22954§chest§tʃest§At the very bottom of the chest were his carving tools.§在**储物箱**的最底部有他的雕刻工具。§
22955§tanker§ˈtæŋkə(r)§She looked around for any kind of vehicle and then found an abandoned fuel tanker.§她四处寻找车辆，随后发现了一辆废弃的**油罐车**。§
22956§capture§ˈkæptʃə(r)§Her beautiful smile was captured through a camera by her husband.§她的动人笑容被她丈夫用照相机**捕捉**了下来。§
22957§overestimate§ˌəʊvərˈestɪmeɪt§The company overestimated his ability when they employed him.§这家公司在雇用他时**高估**了他的能力。§
22958§overview§ˈəʊvəvjuː§Susan usually gives us a brief overview of what this class will involve.§苏珊通常在上课之前会就这节课的内容做一个**概述**。§
22959§pathway§ˈpɑːθweɪ§There are new pedestrian pathways being built alongside the road.§这条路周围要修建新的步行**路**。§
22960§perplex§pəˈpleks§The leukaemia has continued to perplex doctors on how to heal.§白血病如何治愈的问题始终**困扰**着医生。§

22961§recognition§ˌrekəɡˈnɪʃn§The machine detected her briefly, but there was no sign of recognition.§机器对她进行了检测，但是没有一丝**识别**出来的迹象。§改例句：detect 是及物动词，detected briefly towards her 不通，改为 detected her briefly
22962§reconstruction§ˌriːkənˈstrʌkʃn§There will be a huge project for the post-war reconstruction for the tribe.§这个部落的战后**重建**将是非常巨大的工程。§
22963§render§ˈrendə(r)§Thousands of people were rendered homeless by the terrible earthquake.§可怕的地震**使得**成千上万的人们流离失所。§改译文：原译「可怕的地震过后，」没译出 render（使得），改为「可怕的地震使得」
22964§renewal§rɪˈnjuːəl§There is a renewal of interest in traditional Chinese medicine therapy.§最近传统的中医疗法**重新**开始受到关注。§
22965§requisition§ˌrekwɪˈzɪʃn§For the terrible civil war, there is a requisition for a large number of guns by the government.§因为可怕的内战，该政府要求**征用**大量枪支。§
22966§reserved§rɪˈzɜːvd§Ellen was a shy, reserved girl who rarely took part in the club activities.§埃伦是一位害羞**内向**的女孩，她很少参加社团活动。§
22967§resolve§rɪˈzɒlv§Attempts are continually being made to resolve the problem of security in school.§人们不断尝试着**解决**学校的安全问题。§改例句：are continued being made 语法错，continued 改为 continually
22968§sack§sæk§The corn was stored in large sacks in the barn.§谷物用大**麻袋**装着储存在粮仓里面。§
22969§slide§slaɪd§For frequent usage, the drawers slide in and out easily.§由于频繁使用，抽屉很容易**滑**进滑出。§改译文：原译「被拉出和推进」没译出 slide（滑动），改为「滑进滑出」
22970§slump§slʌmp§Sales of clothing have slumped sharply this year.§今年衣服的销量**大幅下降**。§
22971§surface§ˈsɜːfɪs§It seems like a difficult problem on the surface, but in fact it is easy to solve.§这个问题**表面**上看起来很难，但实际上很容易解决。§
22972§tickle§ˈtɪkl§I tickled my little brother's feet with a feather.§我用一根羽毛来**挠**弟弟的脚。§
22973§transportation§ˌtrænspɔːˈteɪʃn§There is a need for huge improvement in public transportation.§公共**交通系统**需要大幅度的提高和改善。§改例句：a need of 应为 a need for；promotion（晋升，推销）用词错，照译文「提高和改善」改为 improvement
22974§unanimous§juˈnænɪməs§Unanimous agreement should be reached for this plan to go ahead.§这项计划需要全体人员**一致**通过才能进行。§
22975§underestimate§ˌʌndərˈestɪmeɪt§The statistics show that the number of people affected by the H1N1 has been seriously underestimated.§这项数据显示之前严重**低估**了甲流患者的数量。§

22976§understandable§ˌʌndəˈstændəbl§Only when I have put the trial into practice can it be understandable to everyone.§只有我将此试验实现大家才会**理解**。§改例句：Only 后缺 when 引导的从句；have got to（必须）用词错，改为 Only when I have put
22977§transcribe§trænˈskraɪb§She transcribed a letter on the typewriter.§她用打字机**打印**了一封信。§
22978§differ§ˈdɪfə(r)§French differs from English in this respect.§法语在这方面**不同于**英语。§
22979§undertake§ˌʌndəˈteɪk§Mary undertook the organization of the whole scheme.§玛丽**负责**整个计划的组织工作。§
22980§plus§plʌs§The psychologist found a word without a picture was superior to a word plus a picture for children.§心理学家发现，对孩子们而言没有附上图片的词比**加**了图片的词更好一些。§
22981§recycle§ˌriːˈsaɪkl§The man collects the waste bins and deposits the waste into a shredder for recycling.§这个人把垃圾箱收集起来，把垃圾倒进搅碎机进行**回收利用**。§
22982§captive§ˈkæptɪv§Today approximately 10 species might be said to have been "saved" by captive breeding programmes.§据说现在大约有10个物种在**圈养**繁殖计划中获得了“拯救”。§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
22983§unconquerable§ʌnˈkɒŋkərəbl§This place in their hearts was unconquerable.§这个地方在他们心目中是**不可征服**的。§
22984§respect§rɪˈspekt§I respect you for your honesty.§因为你为人诚实，所以我**尊敬**你。§
22985§neutral§ˈnjuːtrəl§The feminist took neutral ground during the first interview.§这名女权主义者在第一次采访中采取了**中立**的态度。§
22986§presentation§ˌpreznˈteɪʃn§We'd better fix the problem before the presentation.§我们最好在做**报告**之前解决这个问题。§
22987§residence§ˈrezɪdəns§Without permission, students may not be allowed to keep motor vehicles at their residence in this university.§未经校方同意，学生不允许在校内的**住宿区**停放机动车辆。§
22988§mission§ˈmɪʃn§The forces were sent to complete a secret mission in an uncharted place.§这些军队被派遣到一个地图上未标明的地方去执行一项秘密**任务**。§
22989§assurance§əˈʃʊərəns§She answered every question in the job interview with calm assurance, which impressed the whole panel.§她冷静而充满**信心**地回答了面试中的每个问题，给整个面试小组留下了深刻印象。§补例句
22990§content§ˈkɒntent§The meeting leader concerns himself with the content of the meeting.§会议的主办者本人很关心会议的**内容**。§
22991§emit§iˈmɪt§Older trucks, buses and taxis emit excessive levels of smoke and fumes.§老式卡车、公交车和出租车**排放**出过量的烟和废气。§
22992§pamphlet§ˈpæmflət§The pamphlet was regarded as a masterpiece of wit.§这本**小册子**被看成智慧的杰作。§
22993§equipment§ɪˈkwɪpmənt§Last week we talked about buying camping equipment.§上周我们讨论了有关购买露营**装备**的事情。§
22994§sensible§ˈsensəbl§This week's lecture is on sensible eating.§本周的讲座是关于**合理**饮食的。§
22995§spacecraft§ˈspeɪskrɑːft§We've done a lot on the study of spacecraft returning technique.§我们已在**航天器**返回技术上做了很多研究工作。§
22996§consequence§ˈkɒnsɪkwəns§The consequence of the Human Genome Project goes far beyond a narrow focus on disease.§人类基因工程的**重要意义**远远不止于治愈疾病。§
22997§efficient§ɪˈfɪʃnt§The financial analyst found efficient ways for the company to save money.§财务分析师找到了能够**有效**地替公司省钱的方法。§
22998§current§ˈkʌrənt§I would like to open a current account.§我想开一个**活期**存款账户。§
22999§inversion§ɪnˈvɜːʃn§The inversion of the image on the retina is corrected by the brain, so we see the world the right way up.§视网膜上图像的**倒置**会由大脑加以纠正，所以我们看到的世界是正的。§补例句
23000§elevate§ˈelɪveɪt§John has been elevated to manager.§约翰已被**提升**为经理。§
23001§loan§ləʊn§Does this mean I'm not eligible for a student loan?§这是不是意味着我不符合学生**贷款**的条件？§
23002§capable§ˈkeɪpəbl§The bridge is capable of carrying 150-tonne trucks.§这座桥**能够**承受载重150公吨的卡车。§

23003§performance§pəˈfɔːməns§Profits continue to grow, with strong performance in Asia and South America.§利润持续增长，其中亚洲及南美市场**表现**尤为强劲。§改译文：原译「这一点在…表现尤为明显」里的「表现」是动词（显出），不是 performance（业绩表现），改为「其中…表现尤为强劲」
23004§handicapped§ˈhændikæpt§Toilets for handicapped people are located on this floor, with a sign of a wheelchair on the door.§**残疾**人厕所就在本楼层，门上有一个轮椅的标志。§改例句：可数名词单数 wheelchair 前缺冠词，补 a
23005§insulate§ˈɪnsjuleɪt§The familiar native-style hotels could insulate the tourist from the strangeness of the host environment.§这种似曾相识的本土风格的旅馆能够**避免**让游客在异乡产生陌生感。§
23006§household§ˈhaʊshəʊld§I've been investigating four new household gadgets and sorting out their advantages and disadvantages.§我已就四种**家居**新产品做了调查，并将它们的优缺点分门别类。§
23007§detrimental§ˌdetrɪˈmentl§Smoking cigarettes is detrimental to your health.§吸烟**有害**健康。§
23008§decorate§ˈdekəreɪt§We moved into our new apartment before it was decorated.§新公寓还没有**装修**，我们就搬进去了。§改例句：搬进某处应为 move into，in 改为 into
23009§nationality§ˌnæʃəˈnæləti§Can you show any proof of your nationality?§你能出示可以证明你**国籍**的证件吗？§
23010§fleet§fliːt§Governments assembled the world's largest fleet of dredgers to suck up mud in the ocean.§各国政府共同组建了世界上最大的挖泥**船队**，去挖掘大洋海底的淤泥。§
23011§interfere§ˌɪntəˈfɪə(r)§Carbon monoxide may interfere with the blood's ability to deliver oxygen to the heart.§一氧化碳会**妨碍**血液向心脏供氧。§
23012§signal§ˈsɪɡnəl§Serotonin is a chemical substance involved in sending signals in the nervous system.§血清素是一种在神经系统中参与传递**信号**的化学物质。§
23013§rescue§ˈreskjuː§Several school children were rescued from the burning building.§几名小学生被从燃烧的大楼里成功**救出**。§
23014§proof§pruːf§Can you provide any proof of identity?§你能提供任何身份**证明**吗？§
23015§afflict§əˈflɪkt§Financial difficulties afflicted the Smiths.§经济问题**困扰**着史密斯一家。§
23016§log§lɒg§The earliest peoples probably stored fire by keeping slow burning logs alight.§早期的人类很可能是通过让**原木**保持缓慢燃烧的状态来保存火种的。§
23017§maritime§ˈmærɪtaɪm§You can call or send a message to someone aboard a ship by using our Maritime Services.§你可以通过我们的**海运**服务给船上的人打电话或发信息。§
23018§formula§ˈfɔːmjələ§John Walker, an English pharmacist, borrowed the formula from a military rocket-maker called Congreve.§一名叫约翰·沃克的英国药剂师从一位名叫康格里夫的军用火箭制造商那里借用了**配方**。§
23019§therapy§ˈθerəpi§We are beginning to realise the unique benefits of relaxation therapy in curing back pain.§我们正开始认识到放松**疗法**对背痛具有独特的疗效。§
23020§concession§kənˈseʃn§You will get what is called a "student account", which is a current account with special concessions for students.§你将获得一个名为“学生账户”的活期账户，这是专为学生开设的，有特殊**优惠**措施。§改例句：中文引号改为英文引号
